name: kijam
description: Multiplayer collectible card game: authoritative server, STEEM identity and payments, purchases, packs, card trades and game results recorded on-chain

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f deploy/compose.local.yml --env-file deploy/local.env up --build -d --wait
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f deploy/compose.local.yml --env-file deploy/local.env logs -f app
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f deploy/compose.local.yml --env-file deploy/local.env down
